# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 58 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 58 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_058_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 5, Part 4 — The True Fast: Almsgiving

**58:1** "Lord," I said, "I should also like to learn what the fasting means. How should we fast?" "Listen," he said. "The fast that you are to observe is this: when you fast on the appointed days, take no food at all until the ninth hour. But the foods that you would have eaten on that day, eat them after the ninth hour of the day of the fast. And whatever is saved from your foods, give it to a widow, or an orphan, or to someone in need. So you humble yourself, in order that the one who receives may be filled from your act of humbling, and may pray to the Lord on your behalf."

**58:2** "If therefore you accomplish this fast as I have explained it, your sacrifice will be acceptable before God, and this fast will be recorded; and the service performed in this way is beautiful and rejoicing and acceptable to the Lord."

**58:3** "These things you shall observe with your children and with all your household. And when you observe them, you shall be blessed. And all who hear these words and observe them shall be blessed; and whatever they ask of the Lord they shall receive."

---

*LOGOS renders according to the Greek text of P.Mich. 130 with attention to formal correspondence and the practical fast-instruction that concludes Similitude 5.*
